FEATURE GUIDE

System Runner & owl light

Keep your owl, add a moving rim of light, and check your Mac at a glance.

Next update preview · Mac

These additions are being prepared for the next Mac update. They are not included in the public Mac 1.5.19 build35 download or Windows 1.5.13. The download buttons still provide those public releases.

OverviewHow to useExampleSupport & limitsRelated features

Overview

The optional System Runner shares the existing owl’s menu-bar item. Its default Owl eye light keeps the eye shapes still while light travels around their rims. Higher CPU usage makes the motion faster.

Animal mode offers a hamster, rabbit or cat. Your owl and departure display remain, and your animal selection is saved.

How to use

  1. Open Settings → Plugin management and install System Runner. Installation leaves it off; turn on Use plugin as well.
  2. Open Installed plugins → System Runner below the sidebar divider and choose owl light or an animal.
  3. In owl mode, choose the start and end colors, check the gradient preview, or restore the default colors.
  4. Click the menu-bar item for a system summary. Open the plugin settings for detailed readings and measurement status.

Example

The default light uses cyan #14C9FF and purple #AD58FF. Changing colors preserves the eye shapes and rotation phase. These readings come from the Mac app; this website does not collect device metrics.

MetricWhat it shows
CPUOverall CPU usage. This controls owl-light and animal speed.
MemoryUsed and total memory, plus macOS memory pressure.
DiskStartup-disk capacity and available space, not read/write throughput.
NetworkReceive/send rates across connected physical Wi-Fi and Ethernet interfaces; excludes VPN and virtual interfaces.
BatteryCharge and power state; Macs without a battery are identified separately.

Support & limits

CPU, memory and network refresh every second; disk and battery readings are cached for five seconds. Unavailable or first readings show — or a status message, never a fabricated zero.

Only CPU controls animation speed. Other metrics are informational. macOS Reduce Motion stops animation, and Low Power Mode reduces visual updates.

Turning the plugin off stops measurement and animation while preserving the presentation, colors and animal. No account, calendar permission or external service is needed.
